name: Greentown Service Group Co. Ltd.
summary: Greentown Service Group Co. Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides residential property management services in the People's Republic of China and internationally. The company offers property management services, such as security, cleaning, gardening, and repair and maintenance services; and consulting services comprising project planning, design management, construction management, marketing management consulting services, digital products and service solutions, and management consulting services to real estate developers, property management companies, and governments.
